title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.7 - Feedback & German Localization
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.7 - Feedback & German Localization

- Feedback is now directly accessible from the sidebar throughout the Launcher.
- Game pages have a visible feedback button that automatically includes the selected game.
- Settings also has its own feedback tab. The existing protected delivery system remains unchanged.
- Corrected German release notes in Community and About, including past updates from version 0.16.1 onward.
- Games, achievements, accounts, saves, Discord sign-in and Windows/macOS support remain intact.
